summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the date and details for its third quarter fiscal 2026 financial results conference call and webcast, scheduled for September 3, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET. The release notes results will be published at 7:00 a.m. ET that day, with a presentation by President David Taylor and Global CFO Nicolas Ospina. This is a routine earnings notification with no strategic, transactional, or special-situation elements. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other event covered by special-situations classifications. No deal terms, prices, or recommendations are provided.
